description: This file defines the Polymer behavior `IronValidatableBehavior`, which provides validation functionality for custom web components based on Polymer. It includes properties, observers, and methods to handle validation logic, validator references, and accessibility attributes.

methods.name: hasValidator
methods.description: Checks whether a validator with the current `validator` name exists.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the current value; updates `invalid` property and returns the validation result.

methods.name: _getValidity
methods.description: Checks validity using the validator or defaults to true; meant to be overridden for custom validation logic.
